briefing.headline: Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress reported a beat-and-raise quarter, and the stock rose, but Jensen Huang's exit and China chip halt keep the company in the spotlight.

points.text: Nvidia has stopped sending its advanced AI chips to China, even though the White House approved such sales in December last year.
points.label: reported

points.text: Jensen Huang resigned as CEO. The board chair says he voluntarily resigned and the board does not intend to rehire him.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Nvidia beat earnings expectations and its stock rose nearly 4%. Neocloud stocks surged too.
points.label: reported

points.text: Anthropic's IPO is likely to price above the current $70 to $78 range, sources tell CNBC. Wall Street is preparing for it.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia did not file its quarterly SEC report (10-Q), breaking from its usual practice.
points.label: reported
